headline: Invoice prices now use one shared display rule, with no verified customer-facing problem.
what_changed: Invoice line items and invoice totals now show prices through the same shared formatting rule.
Dollar, euro, and pound amounts keep their symbols, while other currencies show their currency code.
New checks confirm comma separators, cents, and an unsupported currency display correctly.
questions_for_developer: Is the individual invoice-line display helper used anywhere outside this invoice module? Its calling pattern changed, so any outside use must be updated.
good_news: The total calculation remains the same, so this change does not alter what customers are charged.
The price-display logic is now kept in one place, reducing the chance that invoice lines and totals show different amounts.
